notablePrerequisites:
Workhorse has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Pentad Prism has at least one charge counter on it.
description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {1}{W}.
Inexorable Tide triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Workhorse and a charge counter on Pentad Prism.
When Whitemane Lion enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Pentad Prism by removing a charge counter from it, adding {W}.
Activate Workhorse by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
